security: Common Stock, $0.0001 par value per share
footnote_text: On October 27, 2026, Issuer entered into a Securities Purchase Agreement (the "Purchase Agreement") with the purchasers signatory thereto and consummated the transactions contemplated thereunder. Pursuant to the Purchase Agreement, Issuer agreed to issue and sell to Reporting Person (i) in a registered direct offering 9,593 shares of Common Stock, $0.0001 par value per share ("Common Stock") and (ii) in a concurrent private placement 45,655 shares of Common Stock and 55,248 accompanying common stock purchase warrants to purchase shares of Common Stock (the "Common Warrants"). The transaction was approved by the Issuer's board of directors in accordance with Rule 16b-3.
